mapper.select: select master.sys_id as master_sys_id, master.table_sys_id, master.table_num, master.insert_datetime, item.sys_id as item_sys_id, item.call_cd, coalesce(setting.call_nm, item.call_cd) as call_nm, item.description, item.quantity from consumer_staff_call_master master join consumer_staff_call item on item.link_sys_id = master.sys_id left join consumer_staff_call_setting setting on setting.sys_plant_cd = master.sys_plant_cd and setting.call_cd = item.call_cd where master.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and master.read_yn = 'N' order by master.insert_datetime asc, master.sys_id asc, item.sys_id asc
mapper.update: update consumer_staff_call_master set read_yn = 'Y' where sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and read_yn = 'N'
